quote: We conducted a user study at Amazon Mechanical Turk to confirm the effectiveness of WORDTOUR. Specifically, to compare two word ordering σ, τ ∈ P([n]), we randomly sample a reference word v ∈ V, retrieve the next words of v in σ and τ , and ask a crowdworker which word is more similar to the reference word v.
